literal_meaning: জলের যোগ বা সংযোগ (water addition or connection)
example_sentences_in_bangla: দুপুরের জলযোগে চা আর বিস্কুট খেলাম।
example_sentences_in_english: Refreshments were served at the party.
I had tea and biscuits as light snacks in the afternoon.
note: Refers to simple, water-based or light beverages and snacks in social gatherings
